title: B6: Remove bottom-bar scale picker and change Add-to-menu icon to calendar
description: In RecipeBottomBar.swift: remove the scale picker that duplicates the one in the Ingredients tab header, so the bottom bar contains exactly two action buttons (Add to menu, Add to shopping list) evenly distributed across available width. Change the SF Symbol on the Add to menu button from 'bookmark' to 'calendar'. If the scale @State was owned by the bottom bar, move ownership to RecipeDetailSheet.swift so the Ingredients-tab picker still binds to the same value. Button label text and accessibility labels are unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Bottom bar contains exactly two action buttons — no scale picker
Two buttons are evenly distributed across available width
Add to menu button uses SF Symbol 'calendar'
Add to menu button label text and accessibility label are unchanged
Ingredients-tab scale picker still binds to the shared scale @State and scales quantities correctly
Single source of truth for scale state — no duplication
